did: Home now keeps each conversation essay's record and serves its previews, so a pick the owner makes on the phone's preview card lands on home instead of staying on the phone. The record is a new append-only log on home, one numbered event after another, and home replays it with the record's own rules before keeping anything, so a refused pick changes nothing. A preview is the agent's offer in that record, and its clips are files on home under the owner's own folder, so nobody else can see them. The some-ui side placed the new store in the assurance ledger first.

calls.title: How much of the record's rules home checks
options: Home checks the record's structural rules and trusts the writers for the cast, emotions and flag-kind rules
Home ports every rule of the record's step, vocabularies included
calls.why: A Rust copy of some-ui's cast and emotion lists would drift from the originals, and every writer already runs the full step before it sends; the coordinator accepted it.
calls.undo: Port the remaining rules into conversation_repo::step, or have the refusal corpus follow-up cover them.

calls.title: Where a conversation's previews live
options: The offer is an event in the record and only the clips are files under the subject's folder
A preview.json manifest beside the clips on home
calls.why: One source for the offer, the record, and a manifest under a shared folder let another subject see previews; HOST-NEXT and the coordinator agreed.
calls.undo: Bring back a manifest reader in file_host's conversations module; the routes keep their shapes.

left: The conversations contract tests and a refusal corpus generated from stepConversation, which the server's step tests read: they wait for the route snapshot to reach some-ui.
The phone switching from its own store to these routes and saying on screen where a pick is kept: that is HOST-NEXT's half, on #3558.
The renderer that writes the preview clips on home: HOST5's follow-up story, which the coordinator files.
